pages.title: Bee Rise
pages.creator: Rick&Jean
pages.description: Guide a queen bee through the meadow to gather nectar in Bee Rise. Hatch workers to keep honey production going and recruit guards to fend off invading wasps. Spend resources on research and upgrades, complete quests, and use rebirth to strengthen the colony for another round of growth.

pages.title: LugRush
pages.creator: LugRush
pages.description: Get your suitcase to the right plane in LugRush. Swipe around trolleys, oil spills, and other bags, then choose a belt at each split before the gate closes. Once you land, guide the bag through baggage claim. The game features 700 airports across 187 countries.

pages.title: Freekick Clash
pages.creator: Sour Mango Games
pages.description: Choose a national team in Freekick Clash and line up a shot with the mouse. Aim around the defensive wall and look for an opening past the goalkeeper. Keep scoring as you work through the tournament toward the World Cup.

pages.title: Obby Escape from Tsunami Brainrot
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Run from an approaching wave in Obby Escape from Tsunami Brainrot. Gather resources and improve your speed and strength so you can survive longer. Grow your base and Brainrot collection, which can keep earning currency while you're away.

pages.title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Turn a run-down fuel stop into a business in Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon. Clear out the junkyard, repair cars, and rebuild the station so you can expand it. Split your attention between the pumps and the garage as you improve the property.

pages.title: People Playground: Ragdoll Battle
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Control a ragdoll fighter in People Playground: Ragdoll Battle. Aim your strikes at vulnerable parts of the opponent and watch how both fighters move after a hit. Earn gold to unlock characters and improve your skills before taking on another fight.

pages.title: Food Jam
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Sort produce and drinks into the right takeout carts in Food Jam. Look for a way to free up blocked items and use power-ups when a jam is hard to clear. Work through more than 500 levels and unlock themes such as desserts and juices.

pages.title: Zombie Survival Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Keep moving as zombies close in from all directions in Zombie Survival Shooter. Shoot the gates that offer the boost you need, such as extra helpers or a faster attack. Choose a route that lets you reach the upgrade without getting surrounded.

pages.title: Conquer.io
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Claim more of the map in Conquer.io by moving beyond your current territory. Watch how your rivals move and pick routes that let you gain ground while defending what you've already taken. Keep expanding as the available space gets more contested.

pages.title: Hexa Stack Christmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Place stacks of holiday tiles onto a hexagonal board in Hexa Stack Christmas. Set stacks with matching colors near each other to sort and collect the tiles. Watch how much space you leave for the next stack, and switch between two modes as you play.

pages.title: Happy ASMR Care
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Choose a cleaning task in Happy ASMR Care and work through it with the tools at hand. Remove barnacles from a turtle, clean a carpet, shave, or trim a hoof. Each mode gives you a different surface and a different job to finish.

pages.title: Emergency Operator
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Decide how to respond to 911 calls in Emergency Operator. Read the situation and send police, firefighters, or medics when they're needed. Some calls require no dispatch. Make accurate decisions to keep the city safe and earn promotions.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Tung Tung Racing
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Pick one of three racers in Italian Brainrot Tung Tung Racing. Customize a Formula car and take it through the game's unusual courses. Watch the route as you build speed and see how your chosen racer fares on the next track.

pages.title: LOL Funny Dance
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Stretch and twist faces in LOL Funny Dance. Drag points on pictures of celebrities or politicians and watch their expressions change as they dance. Move another point to exaggerate a feature or start over with a different face.

pages.title: Burger Cafe - Cooking Games For Kids
pages.creator: Individual entrepreneur DENIS KLIMAV
pages.description: Make burgers from scratch in Burger Cafe - Cooking Games For Kids. Choose a recipe, chop vegetables, make the sauce, and cook the buns and patties. Assemble and package the order for the customer, then unlock more recipes and customize the restaurant as you go.

pages.title: Santa Vs Skritch
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Kick a present past your opponent in Santa Vs Skritch. Choose a side and look for an opening to score while keeping the gift out of your own goal. Play a friend or take on the computer in a holiday duel.

pages.title: Word Voyager
pages.creator: Back to the Game
pages.description: Follow Olivia through a library of word puzzles in Word Voyager. Work through the daily mission and look for hidden stars as you solve puzzles. The stars unlock themed categories when you want a different set of words to find.

pages.title: Supermarket Cashier Simulator
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Work the checkout in Supermarket Cashier Simulator. Enter the prices of groceries, add up the total, and work out how much change the customer should receive. Use the in-game calculator to check your arithmetic as you handle the next purchase.

pages.title: Cards 2048
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Drag cards into open spaces in Cards 2048. Put two cards of the same value together in a column to merge them. Watch which spaces you leave free for the next cards as you work toward making a 2048 card.

pages.title: Superhero Drop and Save
pages.creator: Liones Games
pages.description: Drop onto captors and use small blasts to rescue hostages in Superhero Drop and Save. Check who's standing nearby before setting off an explosion so you can keep the hostages safe. Spend your earnings on hero skins as the rescues get harder.

pages.title: Dead Faces Clone Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search a building where strange things are happening in Dead Faces Clone Online. Follow the clues to find the items each level asks for, and investigate the rooms in 3D. Use what you discover to solve the next part of the mystery.

pages.title: Merge Alphabet 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build an army of letter characters in Merge Alphabet 3D. Combine letters as you work toward stronger characters, and see which ones you've added to your collection. Keep developing the lineup as you unlock more of the alphabet.

pages.title: Dynamons 5
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Build a squad of creatures in Dynamons 5. Explore the Water, Fire, and Electric Temples and the Legendary Cave, then use action cards in turn-based battles. Weaken opposing Dynamons to catch them and change your lineup as your collection grows.

pages.title: Line Color 3D
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Claim territory by drawing colored paths in Line Color 3D. Look for room to expand and keep watch over the areas you've already taken. Opponents can steal territory, so decide when to push outward and when to protect your ground.

pages.title: Feller 3D
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Turn trees into building materials in Feller 3D. Fell the timber, strip the bark, and saw the wood into boards. Use the lumber to build houses, then choose a design and surroundings that suit each one.

pages.title: Save the Panda
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Draw a shelter to keep bees away from the panda in Save the Panda. Think about where the bees will approach before you place the line. The collection also includes Joy Draw and another puzzle mode when you want a different challenge.

pages.title: Connection!
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Connect the dots in one continuous stroke in Connection! Look at the shape before you start and choose a route that can reach every dot. If a path leaves part of the design disconnected, rethink where to begin.

pages.title: Command Strike FPS
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Take on commando assignments in Command Strike FPS. Try Deathmatch, Flag Capture, or Missions against offline opponents. Switch between guns and pistols as you move through different maps and adjust to the objective of each match.

pages.title: Color Chain Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Sort chains by color in Color Chain Sort Puzzle. Before moving a chain, check the top color on its destination pillar. Use matching colors to group the chains, leaving yourself space to move the pieces you still need to sort.

pages.title: Hexa Stapler
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Fit hexagonal pieces into place in Hexa Stapler. Look at the image details and the position of neighboring pieces to decide where each hexagon belongs. Complete the picture and move on to more involved layouts.

pages.title: NoNoSparks Genesis
pages.creator: Beardshaker Games
pages.description: Build a world by solving picture puzzles in NoNoSparks Genesis. Read the number clues along the rows and columns to work out which squares to fill. Each solved nonogram brings another part of the world to life, from plants and animals to people and dinosaurs.

pages.title: Brickz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Build a tower one brick at a time in Brickz! Place each new block with care so the stack stays balanced as it grows. Try to build higher on the next attempt and work through the different levels.

pages.title: MX OffRoad Master
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Ride down mountain tracks or explore at your own pace in MX OffRoad Master. Land spins and finish routes to earn gold and diamonds. Try Mountain Downhill or Free Roam, and ride on your own or share the course with a second player.

pages.title: Santa Claus Finder
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Watch which cup Santa hides under in Santa Claus Finder. Follow that cup as the set changes positions, then select it when the shuffle stops. Keep your attention on Santa's cup even when the others cross its path.

pages.title: Turn Dot
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap to turn a white dot at the corners in Turn Dot. Keep it on the yellow track by changing direction just before it reaches the edge. A collision or a turn off the path ends the run.

pages.title: Arabian Night 1001
pages.creator: Human Soft, Inc
pages.description: Follow Scheherazade's tales in Arabian Night 1001 while searching scenes for hidden objects. Explore stories featuring Aladdin, Sinbad, and Ali Baba, and look for genies that open bonus stories and levels. Read along as the scenes follow the tales.

pages.title: Pen Run
pages.creator: GamingStars
pages.description: Draw a trail with a watercolor pen in Pen Run. Move the pen around obstacles and keep it heading toward the end of the course. Watch what's in front of you so you have time to steer clear as you race for first.

pages.title: Traffic
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Guide a pedestrian to a parked car in Traffic. Look both ways before moving across each road and wait for a gap between vehicles. Work through the crossings on the 100-step route without getting hit.

pages.title: Funny Tattoo Shop
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Create a tattoo and style its model in Funny Tattoo Shop. Pick a design, make a stencil, trace the outline, and add color. Choose an outfit that suits the finished tattoo and work toward the shop's achievements.

pages.title: Car Stunts X
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take a stunt car onto elevated tracks in Car Stunts X. Line up the car before you hit a mega ramp and manage your speed through the next stretch. Try to pull off stunts while keeping the car on the course.

pages.title: Gravity Jump
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tap to make the ball jump in Gravity Jump. Watch for blocks that slide sideways or rotate, then choose when to leap through the opening. If a jump goes wrong, you can retry the level as often as you need.

pages.title: 2020 Porsche Cayenne GTS Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six pictures in 2020 Porsche Cayenne GTS Puzzle. Rebuild it with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Look at the car's shape and details to work out which pieces belong together.

pages.title: Dirt Motorbike Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to rebuild a dirt bike picture in Dirt Motorbike Slide. Choose one of three images and select a mode, then move pieces until their edges and picture details line up. Try another mode for a different version of the layout.

pages.title: Offroad ATV Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of all-terrain vehicles in Offroad ATV Puzzle. Choose one of six images and play with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use details on the ATV and in the background to find where each piece fits.

pages.title: Farm of Dreams
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Match groups of three vegetables in Farm of Dreams. Clear the puzzle boards to earn coins, then use those coins to improve your farm. Return to the matching levels whenever you want to work toward another upgrade.

pages.title: Aqua Challenge
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Stay away from larger fish in Aqua Challenge. Guide your small fish through the ocean and look for open water before the others get too close. Your score measures how many seconds you survive, and a collision ends the attempt.

pages.title: Helix Rotation
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Turn the tower to guide a bouncing ball in Helix Rotation. Line up the openings under the ball to send it down through the platforms. Keep the ball away from red sections as you work toward the bottom.

pages.title: Mango Piggy Piggy Farm
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Aim and launch a hungry pig in Mango Piggy Piggy Farm. Drag to set the direction, then watch where he bounces as he goes after the mangoes. Eat every mango to earn three stars as you work through more than 30 levels.

pages.title: Equations Right or Wrong
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Decide whether each calculation is correct in Equations Right or Wrong. Answer before time expires to earn a point and see the next equation. A wrong answer or a missed deadline ends the run, so balance speed with accuracy.

pages.title: Jewels Blocks Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Place jewel blocks in empty spaces in Jewels Blocks Puzzle. Complete a row to clear space and score points. Try to finish two or more rows together for a bonus, and keep enough room on the board for new blocks.

pages.title: Swing Rider
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Swing above the city in Swing Rider. Click to use your web and move the mouse sideways to avoid attacks. Watch where you're headed after each swing and adjust your course before grabbing on again.

pages.title: Renas Pedicure Spa
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Give Rena a pedicure in Renas Pedicure Spa. Trim and treat her feet, then choose colors, patterns, or tattoos for the finished look. Add sandals or toe rings if you want to give the design another detail.

pages.title: Space Ship Racer Game 2019
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Race anti-gravity craft in Space Ship Racer Game 2019. Steer through science-fiction courses and look for a line that keeps your speed up. Work through the racing career or compete against other pilots on tracks set on distant planets.

pages.title: Car Parts Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Choose a picture of a car part in Car Parts Coloring Book. There are eight drawings and 23 colors to work with. Color the details as you like, then save the finished image or switch to another picture.

pages.title: Candy Bomb Sweet Fever
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Match candies to set off blasts in Candy Bomb Sweet Fever. Look at the sweets around each possible move and choose a swap that makes a group. Clear the match and see what opens up as you work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Monster High GiGi Grant Charisma Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Style a Monster High character in Monster High GiGi Grant Charisma Dressup. Give GiGi a makeover and choose bright clothes that fit her preference for comfort. Try pieces in natural fabrics such as silk as you put the whole look together.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Gold Fish
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel and Liam look after a goldfish in Baby Hazel Gold Fish. Shop for a tank and the items they need to decorate it, then set it up for Goldie. Spend time with the fish as the children learn to care for their new pet.

pages.title: Head to Head Soccer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Take on an opponent in Head to Head Soccer. Watch how the ball bounces and move into position to send it toward the other goal. Stay ready to defend your own side when a shot comes back at you.

pages.title: Striker Dummies
pages.creator: Vardan Aleksanyan
pages.description: Swing a hammer at your opponent in Striker Dummies. Judge when to strike while keeping your own dummy away from the other hammer. Destroy five dummies to win against the computer or a second player.

pages.title: CleanUp.IO
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Vacuum small objects to grow in CleanUp.IO. Start with items you can pick up and move on to larger ones as your vacuum gets bigger. Look for more things to collect as you work toward clearing the map.

pages.title: Domino Legend
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match dominoes to the open ends of the layout in Domino Legend. Choose between Block and Draw, which handle a turn without a playable tile differently. Look at the dots you have left when deciding which tile to put down.

pages.title: Cut it Puzzles
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Draw straight cuts through shapes in Cut it Puzzles. Think about where the pieces will go once you separate them. Aim to collect every star in the layout before moving on to another shape.

pages.title: Kiwi Adventure 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide the kiwi past obstacles in Kiwi Adventure 2. Use the mouse to time your jumps and look for coins you can collect along the way. Keep an eye on the next hazard so you have room to react as the run continues.

pages.title: Pixel Highway
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a pixel car along a crowded road in Pixel Highway. Watch the cars in front and move into a gap before you reach them. Build speed when there's room and stay clear of traffic as you go.

pages.title: Princess Christmas Shopping
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Go shopping with Emma, Belle, and Eliza in Princess Christmas Shopping. Pick festive clothes and accessories for each princess, then try the purchases on. Give the three friends their own outfits for the Christmas celebration.

pages.title: Tap 10 Sec
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Tap as many times as you can in ten seconds in Tap 10 Sec. Use one hand and keep going until the countdown ends. See how many taps you managed, then try again to beat your previous total.

pages.title: At the end zombies win
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fight through crowds of undead in At the end zombies win. Use the weapons at hand and react as more zombies move into reach. Keep track of where the next group is coming from as you try to stay alive.

pages.title: Garage Apocalypse
pages.creator: AlienplayGames
pages.description: Get a broken car running in Garage Apocalypse while zombies close in. Reinforce the doors to buy time and fight off enemies that threaten to get inside. Finish the repairs so you can drive out of the garage.

pages.title: Total Recoil
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fight through RoboCorp's factory in Total Recoil. Dodge and fire at waves of hostile robots across 30 levels. Collect coins to unlock more heroes and see how each one handles the fight.

pages.title: Neon Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Tilt the platform to guide the glowing ball in Neon Ball. Turn it left or right to roll toward the stars and the exit. Keep the ball away from spikes and edges while you work out which way to tilt next.

pages.title: The Maze
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Find a route to the exit in The Maze. Choose easy, medium, or hard, then work your way through the passages. Look for turns that lead away from dead ends as you try to finish quickly.

pages.title: Goldie Princesses Pregnant Check up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help two princesses with their final hospital visit in Goldie Princesses Pregnant Check up. Use the medical tools to work through their checkups, then make a smoothie for them. Finish the visit with music and a belly tattoo for each princess.

pages.title: Carnival Ducks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Shoot targets at a carnival stand in Carnival Ducks. Aim for the hostile ducks and fish as they move past. Leave the peaceful geese alone, because hitting one costs points.

pages.title: Wedding Chef
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate cakes for a royal wedding in Wedding Chef. Pick finishing details for each cake and see how the decorations look together. Get the cakes ready for the celebration and complete the princess's delivery.
